scaleBeatText: A man, maybe 60s walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A woman, maybe 20s, with tattooed arms walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
Almost nobody walks away from this one.
With Haven grieving, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
🚶 Haven walks from the table cleanly — no blades, no hard words. The bond ends where it stood, honestly.

With Haven grieving, Ashford installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
📺 The billing says EXTREME RISK — almost nobody walks away from this one.

Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. Ashford's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.) Ashford installs their own speaker at the table after all — tribute rises to 7,500 kcal/week. Grief became leverage, and they knew it would.
Almost nobody walks away from this one.

📯 Ashford's court summons Haven's speaker. SWEAR the oath of the realm (a gift seals it), SERVE at their court (seven days of your speaker's life), or WALK — break the link and stay a free fire, refusing the scale itself with it (the offer does not return). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.

◈ SYSTEM: "34. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."
📡 Haven feasts for the cameras — 5,020 kcal of theater, every fire of the realm at the table. The chat eats it up. Somewhere, the table makes a note.
◈ SYSTEM: "Species agency: unlocked. You are not at the table yet. But the table has your name now."

◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. The System does not apologize this time. "WE PRICED THE RUN. NO HUNGER ON THE RECORD — THE PELLET HUMS WHERE THE FIRE SHOULD BE. NO FEAST, NO SURGE, NOTHING HERE WE CAN PRICE. A COLD SPOT AT EVERY TABLE: THE WORDS WERE ON THE WRAPPER." The ledger still wants: wave-3 monsters faced. The mantle may pass to hungrier hands; the table will still be here.
Almost nobody walks away from this one.
